context_for_next_testing_agent: Google OAuth wiring is solid. Key facts: (1) The 'Continue with Google' button uses raw window.location.href — to verify the redirect target in Playwright, register a page.on('request', ...) listener BEFORE the click and combine with page.route('**/*', abort if auth.emergentagent.com) so the browser doesn't actually navigate away. Watching framenavigated alone gives 'chrome-error://chromewebdata/' because the abort fires before Playwright records the final URL. (2) Passwordless-user detection key fields in db.users: missing password_hash AND auth_provider='google' — backend uses exact string detail 'This account uses Google sign-in. Please continue with Google.' (frontend toast keys off detail string). (3) Backend google-session endpoint maps ALL upstream errors (Emergent demobackend session-data) to 401 with 'Google sign-in failed. Please try again.' — never 500. (4) JWT is in localStorage as 'botnira_token' (not cookies). (5) Signup.jsx import bug was introduced this iteration and fixed here — confirm the import survives any subsequent main-agent edits.
rca of the issue: Issue: /signup crashed at runtime with 'GoogleAuthButton is not defined'. RCA: Main agent added <GoogleAuthButton .../> JSX usage at Signup.jsx:117 plus the surrounding OR divider but forgot to add the corresponding ES import. Login.jsx had the import on line 6; Signup.jsx did not. Repro: visit /signup → red React error overlay 'Uncaught runtime errors: ReferenceError: GoogleAuthButton is not defined at Signup'. Fix: added 'import GoogleAuthButton from "../components/GoogleAuthButton";' on Signup.jsx line 7 (mirrors Login.jsx). Re-verified: /signup renders cleanly at 390x844 + 1280x900, signup-google-btn click correctly redirects to auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=...%2Fauth%2Fcallback, signup form still submits and advances to OTP verify step.
